meta.title: Lithuanian location bank for the GO-style deck (free Lithuania, 1981)
notes: prompt_phrase describes the LOOK; image models ignore or garble place names, so the name is informational except where naming_the_place_helps is true (famous silhouettes: Trakai, Gediminas tower, Hill of Crosses, Nida dune).
All state_1981 claims are from the cited sources; items in unverified_points are not.

Universal counterfactual rules: tricolour only; no Lenin/Soviet emblems, slogans, red stars; Catholic churches in use; Vilnius Cathedral has its three pediment statues; Kaunas Resurrection church is complete; Hill of Crosses undisturbed; Kaunas Vytautas monument standing; Palanga 'Blessing Christ' standing.

locations.name: Vilnius Old Town street
signature_features: narrow curving cobbled lane between 3-storey rendered houses in ochre, pink and pale green
baroque church tower or gable closing the view
locations.prompt_phrase: narrow curving cobbled lane, tall rendered houses in ochre and faded pink, a baroque church tower closing the view, arched courtyard gate
locations.state_1981: Existed as now; facades shabbier, fewer shop signs, cobbles and trolleybus wires on the wider streets.

locations.name: Gediminas Hill and tower
signature_features: octagonal red-brick tower stump on a steep wooded hill
river Neris or cathedral roofs below
locations.prompt_phrase: steep green hill above red roofs, squat octagonal red-brick tower on top flying a yellow-green-red flag, river bend below
locations.state_1981: Western tower stands (conserved 1930–39; upper floor rebuilt); museum inside since 1960. Funicular up the hill is later.
exclude_built_after_1981_or_demolished: funicular to the hill (2003, unverified date)
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Tricolour on the tower is historically correct for 1919/1939 and the natural choice for the counterfactual; no Soviet flag.

locations.name: Vilnius Cathedral and belfry
signature_features: white classical temple front with six Doric columns and three statues on the pediment
free-standing round-based belfry with a helm roof beside it
locations.prompt_phrase: white colonnaded cathedral front with three statues on the pediment, a tall free-standing round bell tower with a dark helm roof, wide paved square
locations.state_1981: Under Soviet rule it was a picture gallery (taken 1953, returned 1988) and the three pediment statues were removed in 1950 (restored 1997). Roof re-coppered and facades repainted 1980; interior restored from 1981.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Draw it as a working cathedral WITH the three pediment statues (Helena, Casimir, Stanislaus) — the Soviet removal never happened.
Belfry lower part housed a Soviet excursion bureau 1965–89; in the counterfactual just a belfry.

locations.name: Gate of Dawn (Aušros vartai)
signature_features: street closed by a three-storey gate with a renaissance attic
locations.prompt_phrase: narrow street ending in a tall old city gate, chapel windows over the arch, people kneeling on cobbles below, baroque church beside
locations.state_1981: As now; the attic relief carries the Grand Duchy coat of arms (griffins) — heraldry, keep it as a blur.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Open religious practice is normal in the counterfactual; crowds at the chapel are correct.
unverified_points: The relief shows a coat of arms — draw as indistinct carving.

locations.name: Užupis over the Vilnia
signature_features: small river with a stone bridge
crooked old houses stacked up a slope
Bernardine church towers across the water
locations.prompt_phrase: small fast river under a stone bridge, crooked old houses climbing a slope, church towers across the water, washing lines
locations.state_1981: Run-down artisan quarter in 1981; no Angel (2001), no republic signs.

locations.name: Antakalnis — Sts Peter and Paul
signature_features: twin-towered white baroque church on a rise
locations.prompt_phrase: white baroque church with two towers and a dome on a wooded rise, pine trees, a long hospital block of the 1970s nearby
locations.state_1981: Church open throughout (it held St Casimir's relics 1953–89). Hospital blocks 1954 and 1973; polyclinics 1983–84 are borderline.

locations.name: Neris embankment
signature_features: wide slow river with grassy banks and a concrete-railed embankment
church towers one side, new blocks the other
locations.prompt_phrase: wide slow river with grassy banks, low concrete embankment railing, a bridge, church towers on one bank and pale new blocks on the other
locations.state_1981: Žaliasis tiltas (1948–52) and later bridges exist; Soviet statues on the Green Bridge are OUT for the counterfactual.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Green Bridge without its 1952 Socialist-realist statue groups.
unverified_points: Green Bridge statue date 1952 is from the VLE architecture article (bridge 1948–52); statues' exact date unverified.

locations.name: Žvėrynas wooden houses
signature_features: two-storey wooden villas with fretwork eaves and glazed verandas
locations.prompt_phrase: quiet street of two-storey wooden villas, fretwork eaves, glazed verandas, tall limes, a small onion dome at the end
locations.state_1981: Intact wooden suburb; many houses shabby, some divided into flats.

locations.name: Vingis Park
locations.prompt_phrase: tall pines on a river terrace, a great concrete band-shell stage facing a sloping field, river bend behind
locations.state_1981: Stage 1960 (Kotli/Alekna); song festivals held here; stadium 1954.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Song festival crowds in folk costume are correct; replace Soviet banners with the tricolour.

locations.name: Kalvarijų market
signature_features: open stalls under a long low roof
women in headscarves selling from baskets
locations.prompt_phrase: open market stalls under a long low roof, women in headscarves behind baskets of apples and curd, brass scales, wooden crates
locations.state_1981: Historic market on the right bank; details of its 1981 buildings not verified.
unverified_points: Kalvarijų market history not verified in a read source; treat as a generic Vilnius market.

locations.name: Vilnius TV tower (1980)
signature_features: very tall thin concrete shaft with one saucer disc two-thirds up
pine tops and panel blocks below
locations.prompt_phrase: very tall thin concrete tower with a single saucer-shaped disc near the top, pine tops and nine-storey panel blocks at its foot
locations.state_1981: Finished 1980 (326.5 m, deck at 165 m) in Karoliniškės; brand new in 1981.

locations.name: Lazdynai housing district
signature_features: 5- and 9-storey pale panel blocks stepped on a pine slope
locations.prompt_phrase: pale prefabricated apartment blocks stepped along a pine-wooded slope, footpaths between, a Žiguli-sized car on a wide road
locations.state_1981: Begun 1967, finished 1974 (Lenin Prize 1974). Litexpo 1980. Pure late-Soviet modernism — in the counterfactual it reads as 1970s Nordic-style housing; no slogans on roofs.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Keep the architecture, drop roof slogans and red banners.

locations.name: Kaunas — Laisvės alėja
signature_features: long straight boulevard with two rows of limes
locations.prompt_phrase: long straight boulevard with a double row of clipped limes, two-storey ornate facades, a round fountain, people strolling
locations.state_1981: Fountain 1980; pedestrianised boulevard character; Vytautas the Great monument (1932) was destroyed 1952 and rebuilt 1990.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Vytautas monument (1932) still standing in the counterfactual.

locations.name: Kaunas interwar modernism
signature_features: pale smooth rendered 4–6 storey facades, rounded corners, ribbon windows, flat roofs
Christ's Resurrection church tower on the hill
locations.prompt_phrase: pale smooth rendered modernist building with rounded corner and horizontal window bands, flat roof, 1930s lettering-free facade
locations.state_1981: ~1,500 interwar buildings (UNESCO 2023). All present in 1981.
unverified_points: Visual traits (rounded corners, ribbon windows) are my generalisation; UNESCO page gives few visual details.

locations.name: Christ's Resurrection church, Žaliakalnis
signature_features: white stepped block with a 70 m square tower of narrow vertical slits
smaller stepped tower over the altar
seen above the city from the river
locations.prompt_phrase: white monumental church, tall square tower pierced by narrow vertical slit windows, stepped smaller tower behind, on a hill above red roofs
locations.state_1981: Built 1934–40, unfinished; Soviets turned it into the Banga radio factory (returned 1988, completed 2004).
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Draw it COMPLETED and white as a church — the key counterfactual marker of Kaunas.

locations.name: Kaunas Old Town and the confluence
signature_features: red-brick Gothic (Perkūnas house, castle round tower)
two rivers meeting at a grassy point
locations.prompt_phrase: red-brick Gothic castle tower and church gables, slender white town-hall spire, two wide rivers meeting at a grassy point
locations.state_1981: As now; Santaka park largely as grass.
unverified_points: Perkūnas house / town-hall details not re-verified in this pass.

locations.name: Žaliakalnis funicular
signature_features: small boxy wooden-sided car on a steep straight track
locations.prompt_phrase: small boxy funicular car on a steep straight rail track between trees, wooden station hut below, city roofs beyond
locations.state_1981: Two funiculars (Žaliakalnis 1931, Aleksotas 1935 — VLE gives 'two funiculars'; years unverified).

locations.name: Pažaislis monastery
signature_features: baroque church with a tall hexagonal dome and two towers
pine woods and the Kaunas lagoon
locations.prompt_phrase: pink-and-white baroque monastery church with a tall domed drum and twin towers behind a long wall, pines, a wide reservoir
locations.state_1981: Kaunas lagoon (1959) exists. Monastery used as a psychiatric hospital/ museum under the Soviets.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Working convent (Sisters of St Casimir since 1920) in the counterfactual.
unverified_points: Dome colour/shape detail from general knowledge.

locations.name: Kaunas railway station (1953)
signature_features: symmetrical stone-faced station with a clock tower
locations.prompt_phrase: symmetrical stone-faced railway station with a central clock tower, green carriages at a low platform, wide forecourt with a bus
locations.state_1981: Built 1953 (architect P. Ašastinas), Stalinist-neoclassical.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: In a free Lithuania the style would differ; acceptable as 'heavy 1950s neoclassical station' without emblems.

locations.name: Klaipėda old town
signature_features: timber-framed (fachwerk) warehouses with dark beams on white
locations.prompt_phrase: timber-framed warehouses, dark beams on whitewashed infill, steep red-tiled roofs, cobbled quay along a small river with moored boats
locations.state_1981: Fachwerk and brick warehouses (18th–19th c.) on Aukštoji/Daržų streets survive; theatre square. Ännchen statue absent until 1989.
exclude_built_after_1981_or_demolished: sailing ship Meridianas on the Danė (placed 1971, unverified)
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Queen of Peace church (1960) was converted to a concert hall in 1963 — in the counterfactual it stands as a church with its tall tower.

locations.name: Klaipėda port and Smiltynė ferry
signature_features: cranes and black-hulled ships across the strait
small flat ferry crossing to a pine-and-dune shore
locations.prompt_phrase: harbour cranes and a dark ship's hull across a narrow strait, a small flat passenger ferry crossing to a pine-covered sandy shore
locations.state_1981: Ferry to Smiltynė operates; Sea Museum in Kopgalis fort opened 1979.
unverified_points: Ferry service history not verified in a read source.

locations.name: Šiauliai — cathedral and Vilniaus street
signature_features: tall white renaissance cathedral with a single very tall spire
long straight pedestrian street with lamps and benches
locations.prompt_phrase: tall white church with one very tall pointed spire above a long straight pedestrian street, lamp posts, benches, low 1970s shop fronts
locations.state_1981: Cathedral (1625) stands; Vilniaus street boulevard pedestrianised in the 1970s (year unverified). Sundial square with golden archer is 1986 — OUT.
exclude_built_after_1981_or_demolished: Sundial square and 'Šaulys' golden archer (1986, unverified)
unverified_points: Pedestrian street date (1975) and sundial (1986) unverified.

locations.name: Panevėžys — Nevėžis and theatre
signature_features: low flat town on a slow river with an old riverbed pond (Senvagė)
locations.prompt_phrase: flat quiet town, slow river with a willow-lined old-riverbed pond, a low 1960s modernist theatre block, a tiny narrow-gauge train
locations.state_1981: Theatre building 1967; cathedral 1930; narrow-gauge viaduct 1938; Ekranas factory 1962.

locations.name: Trakai island castle
signature_features: red-brick castle with a tall square keep on a small island
locations.prompt_phrase: red-brick castle with a tall square keep on a small lake island, long wooden footbridge, rowing boats, reeds
locations.state_1981: Palace rebuilt 1953–62 (museum); forecastle completed 1987.
exclude_built_after_1981_or_demolished: forecastle restoration (1987) — draw the outer ward lower/partly ruined

locations.name: Trakai Karaim street
signature_features: small wooden houses gable-end to the street, each with three windows in the gable
locations.prompt_phrase: row of small wooden houses set gable-end to the street, each gable with exactly three windows, painted shutters, lake glimpsed behind
locations.state_1981: Karaim houses as now; kenesa stands.

locations.name: Druskininkai spa
signature_features: pine forest on a steep Nemunas bank
locations.prompt_phrase: pine forest on a steep river bank, wooden spa villas with glazed verandas, a low white colonnaded spa building, people with cups
locations.state_1981: Balneology building 1980 (Šilinskai); interwar villas; Soviet sanatoria blocks of the 1970s exist.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Sanatoria without Soviet names; interwar-villa character foregrounded.

locations.name: Palanga pier and Birutė hill
signature_features: long wooden pier into the sea
wooded dune with a small brick chapel on top
locations.prompt_phrase: long wooden pier on piles running out into a grey sea, wooded dune with a small brick chapel on top, pines, bathers
locations.state_1981: Pier wooden (1882/1932) until the 1998 concrete one; Birutė chapel 1869; Tiškevičiai palace = Amber Museum since 1963; Jūratė ir Kastytis 1961, Birutė statue 1965, Šaulys 1981.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: 'Blessing Christ' statue in the palace park (1901) was removed 1952 — present in the counterfactual.

locations.name: Nida and the Curonian Spit
signature_features: huge bare sand dune falling to a lagoon
low fishermen's houses with reed roofs and carved weathervanes
locations.prompt_phrase: huge bare sand dune sloping to a flat lagoon, low wooden fishermen's houses with reed-thatched roofs and a carved pierced weathervane
locations.state_1981: Lutheran church 1888, Thomas Mann house 1930, lighthouse; Neringa town since 1961; Catholic church 2003 — OUT.
unverified_points: House colours (blue/brown with white trim) not verified in a read source.

locations.name: Kernavė mounds
signature_features: four grassy flat-topped mounds side by side above a river valley
locations.prompt_phrase: four steep grassy flat-topped mounds in a row above a wide river valley, a small brick neo-Gothic church behind them
locations.state_1981: Mounds as now; church c. 1920; UNESCO 2004; Moses statue 2000 — OUT; no festival.

locations.name: Hill of Crosses
signature_features: small mound bristling with thousands of wooden and iron crosses
locations.prompt_phrase: small grassy mound crowded with thousands of wooden and iron crosses of every size, path up the middle, flat fields around
locations.state_1981: Soviets bulldozed it 1961 and 1973–75; crosses rebuilt secretly. In the counterfactual it is dense and undisturbed.
free_lithuania_1981_adjustments: Draw it full, old and weathered — no destruction ever happened.

locations.name: Rumšiškės-type farmstead (open-air museum)
signature_features: log farmhouse, granary on stones, wattle fence, sweep well
locations.prompt_phrase: log farmhouse with wide eaves, small granary on corner stones with open gallery, wattle fence, sweep well, orchard, roadside cross
locations.state_1981: Museum opened 1974 (unverified date); used here as the generic authentic farmstead model.

locations.name: Žemaitija farmstead
signature_features: long low troba with half-hipped roof and gable vents, wide eaves
locations.prompt_phrase: long low log farmhouse with half-hipped roof, triangular gable vents and deep eaves, pond, big old trees, a roofed shrine-post at the gate
locations.state_1981: Many such farmsteads survived in Žemaitija; in the counterfactual all do.

locations.name: Aukštaitija street village and lakes
signature_features: houses in a row gable-end to one street
locations.prompt_phrase: row of small log houses set gable-end to a single village street, picket fences, a long lake and low hills behind
locations.state_1981: Street villages mostly broken up by 1939; in a free Lithuania more single farms, but a few street villages remain (Aukštaitija NP).

locations.name: Dzūkija forest village
signature_features: log pirkia with projecting corner logs and painted two-colour shutters
locations.prompt_phrase: small log house with projecting corner joints and two-colour painted shutters, sandy track, tall pines, baskets of mushrooms
locations.state_1981: Forest villages (Marcinkonys, Zervynos type) intact.

locations.name: Suvalkija single farmstead
signature_features: symmetrical boarded stuba with red clay-tile roof and glazed porch
square yard ringed by rows of trees
locations.prompt_phrase: symmetrical boarded farmhouse with red clay-tile roof and glazed porch, square yard ringed by rows of tall trees, flat fields
locations.state_1981: Prosperous interwar farms; the counterfactual keeps them.

locations.name: Neris valley
signature_features: wide river in a deep wooded valley with sandy bluffs
locations.prompt_phrase: wide river curving through a deep wooded valley, pale sandy bluff on the outer bank, pines above, a wooden boat
locations.state_1981: As now.

locations.name: Nemunas valley
signature_features: very wide river with high steep banks, castle mounds and manor spires
locations.prompt_phrase: very wide slow river with high steep wooded banks, a small flat ferry, a church spire on the bluff
locations.state_1981: As now.

locations.name: Aukštaitija lakes (Labanoras)
signature_features: chain of long lakes between wooded hills
locations.prompt_phrase: long narrow lake between pine-wooded hills, reed beds, a wooden rowing boat, a small wooden bell-tower on the shore
locations.state_1981: Labanoras region: 285 lakes, Labanoras belfry.

locations.name: Dzūkija pine forest
signature_features: straight pine trunks on pale sand and lichen
locations.prompt_phrase: straight red-brown pine trunks on pale sand and grey lichen, heather, a figure with a wicker basket
locations.state_1981: As now.

locations.name: Čepkeliai raised bog
signature_features: flat open bog with sparse stunted pines
locations.prompt_phrase: flat open bog with sparse stunted pines, white cotton-grass tufts, dark still pools, a low wooded ridge far off
locations.state_1981: Reserve since 1975; boardwalk later.

rotation_rule.method: Deterministic: take a stable hash of the card's lemma (not its index); if hash mod 100 < 70 the card gets a location from its category list, chosen by hash mod len(list); otherwise generic. Re-roll only if the same location was used by the previous card in the same category.
rotation_rule.caps: No single location above 8 % of located cards; Vilnius Old Town and Rumšiškės-type farmstead are the natural overflow sinks, so cap them first.
always_generic: objects shown in isolation (cup, key, pencil)
verbs of thinking/feeling without a scene
animals shown alone (use farm/forest location only when the card shows a scene)
eligible: any card whose scene has a background: places, transport, weather, seasons, work, leisure, food at table, family at home, school, church, farm, nature
rotation_rule.soft_preference: Prefer region-generic locations (Žemaitija/Dzūkija/Suvalkija/Aukštaitija farms, Old Town street, lake, pine forest) for 2/3 of located cards and famous silhouettes (Trakai, Gediminas tower, Hill of Crosses, Nida dune, TV tower, Resurrection church) for at most 1/3, so the deck does not read as a postcard set.
